coverage_guards.reason: A section is stated in the form it was written. INI has no standard, so a header repeated later in the file, a dotted header such as [core.hooks] and a header the consuming tool treats as a continuation of an earlier one are all separate declarations here; the merged effective configuration must be asked of the tool that reads the file.

A value is stored as the text the grammar took to the end of the line, trimmed and otherwise unaltered. Quoting conventions differ by dialect, and interpolation such as %(home)s, ${VAR} or $ENV is not expanded, so the stored value is what was authored and not what the application will see.

This grammar recognises only the `key = value` spelling with a whole-line comment. A dialect that separates with `:`, continues a value on an indented following line, or ends a value with a trailing `;` comment is parsed by those rules anyway, so such a setting may be missing or may carry more text than its value.
